newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends lower in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends lower in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.05 lower at 41.10 to the dollar in the kerb market on Saturday owing to a slight shortage of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rupee is likely to open lower after the Sunday weekend, one dealer said. The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.55 percent compared to the opening at 2.70 percent.
